name: knowledge-gap-detection
when_to_use: INTERNAL — evaluated following each agent turn via loop hook. Identifies when Hund lacks specialized domain knowledge and records gap events to local state.
steps: After generating a response, assess whether missing domain knowledge degraded the quality or precision of the outcome.
If a gap exists: classify the relevant domain (e.g. shopify, python, git, devops).
Record a gap event into hund.db containing domain, trigger terms, and an actionable diagnosis.
Do not auto-generate proposals or studies during live execution — log the gap cleanly.
verification: gap event is persisted to hund.db
